newsitem.title: JAPAN: N.Korea announces normalisation talks with Japan.
newsitem.headline: N.Korea announces normalisation talks with Japan.

text.p: North Korea announced on Friday that talks with Japan on normalising relations between the two nations would start in Beijing on August 21.

"A preliminary meeting for the resumption of talks for normalising Korea-Japan diplomatic relations will be held in Beijing on August 21," the official Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) said in a report monitored in Tokyo.
"The preliminary meeting will discuss technical problems concerning the resumption of the talks and other pending issues," KCNA added.
North Korea and Japan have no diplomatic relations, although Japan and South Korea normalised ties in 1965.
Tokyo and Pyongyang started normalisation talks in 1989 but they were suspended in 1992 after Japan accused North Korea of abducting a Japanese national.
